subject.title: feat(feishu): bot-to-bot conversation support with @mention handling

question: Should Feishu preserve omitted allowBots as a bot-admitting default with loop protection, or require an explicit/restrictive default before landing this bot-to-bot support?
rationale: The implementation appears to preserve current bot-authored ingress while adding safeguards, but that default can change live operator behavior and message delivery once the Feishu app scope is present.

options.title: Approve Current Default After Refresh
options.body: Keep omitted allowBots as accepting bot-authored Feishu messages, rely on default-on loop protection, and require a conflict-resolved re-review before merge.

options.title: Require Restrictive Admission
options.body: Change the default to allowBots: "mentions" or false so upgrades do not admit broader bot-authored traffic unless operators choose it.

options.title: Pause For Broader Channel Policy
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers define a cross-channel bot-admission default policy for Feishu, Slack, Discord, and future bot-to-bot channels.

recommendation.title: Approve Current Default After Refresh
recommendation.body: Keep omitted allowBots as accepting bot-authored Feishu messages, rely on default-on loop protection, and require a conflict-resolved re-review before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu channel history ties this owner to the same bot, reply-dispatcher, outbound, and config surfaces where the product default is implemented.
